content: Mapping between the EcuAbstractionSwComponentType and the corresponding BswModuleDescription The BSW part is described by the means of the Basic Software Module Template . The mapping between the EcuAbstractionSwComponentType and the corresponding BswModuleDescrip- tion is provided by the class SwcBswMapping which in addition also maps the two 655 of 1277 Document ID 62: AUTOSAR_CP_TPS_SoftwareComponentTemplate Software Component Template AUTOSAR CP R25-11 corresponding InternalBehavior s.
